batch: 2026-11-14 Kuchai Lama（俊宇：找新目标，可以是中国餐厅；再找不一样的咖啡店）
source: 查了 Kuchai Lama / Happy Garden / Taman Continental 40 多家餐厅和咖啡店（Chiefeater、Malay Mail、FMT、Eat Drink KL、Trusted Malaysia、KLFoodie、TheSmartLocal）。2026-11-14 起没有 IG 但有手机号码的也放（俊宇「用默认」）。

leads.name: The Baking Trip
leads.contact_source: FMT 2023-07 报道和 Eat Drink KL 专题列出的电话；FMT 写订单走 Instagram
leads.address: A6, Jalan Rukun 7, Taman Gembira (Happy Garden), off Jalan Kuchai Lama, 58200 KL
leads.why: Happy Garden（Kuchai Lama 旁）一栋洋房里的酸种面包和蛋糕店，2015 年开始做；FMT、Eat Drink KL 报道过；订单只靠 IG 私信，没有网站或网上点餐。
leads.verify: 星期三到日 9am–6pm 才开（星期一、二休息）；看 IG 简介有没有别的下单连结；问他们圣诞 / 农历新年有没有预购、整个蛋糕要提早几天订。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Sourdough bakery in a bungalow at A6, Jalan Rukun 7, Taman Gembira (Happy Garden), off Jalan Kuchai Lama, KL 58200. Sourdough breads (24-hour process), blueberry raisin cream cheese rye, cream cheese cheddar boule, buns and bagels, grilled cheese sandwiches, cakes and pastries; they have made occasion cakes including a wedding cake. Open Wed-Sun 9am-6pm. It is a pick-up shop, not a cafe.
Signals: Started online in 2015 (founder Gillian Beh, self-taught; learned sourdough from an artisan in Thailand); grew from baking whole cakes in a small Serdang apartment to the Happy Garden bungalow. FMT Lifestyle feature (11 Jul 2023, 'House called The Baking Trip sells glorious breads and cakes'); Eat Drink KL featured post calling it Happy Garden's home for the neighbourhood's widest variety of sourdough specialities and cakes; Chiefeater review (whisky raisin bun, RM20-50 per pax).
Budget signal: A whole bungalow as the bakery, media coverage, whole cakes and occasion cakes; in business since 2015.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh thebakingtrip, bakingtrip, thebakingtripkl -> NONE. (b) No website, Beep, StoreHub or take.app page found; FMT 2023 says the team accepts orders on Instagram, Eat Drink KL lists 'Order on IG'. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @_thebakingtrip_ (FMT 2023); phone 019-576 1419 (FMT 2023 and Eat Drink KL).
Observation: FMT (Jul 2023): the sourdough takes 24 hours to make; her partner is now the main baker and her sister makes the cakes and pastries.
Angle: Orders come in by Instagram DM today. A pre-order page with pick-up days and time slots (bread sells out), whole-cake orders with a lead time, and Christmas / Chinese New Year bakes with a cut-off date (RM399 festive shop or RM800 website).
Sources: https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/leisure/2023/07/11/house-called-the-baking-trip-sells-glorious-breads-and-cakes ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/featured/the-baking-trip-happy-garden-s-wholesome-home-for-the-neighbourhood-s-widest-variety-of-sourdough-specialities-cakes ; https://chiefeater.com/single-location/kuchai-lama

leads.name: Surreal Cafe & Dining
leads.contact_source: 搜索结果里 Facebook 专页（Surreal Cafe & Dining）的摘要：电话、Email、IG（2026-11 看到）
leads.address: 1-7, Dataran Loka, Jalan Kuchai Lama, 58200 KL
leads.why: Dataran Loka 的 Dalí 壁画咖啡馆，Bukit Jalil 康普茶咖啡馆 Scoby 的姐妹店：菠萝 tepache 等发酵饮料，加上扇贝 pie tee、意粉、饭碗；Eat Drink KL、TheSmartLocal 2025 报道；没有网站。
leads.verify: 中午 12 点才开（星期二休息）；问他们的发酵饮料能不能装瓶外带 / 送货；看 IG 简介有没有点餐连结。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Cafe and dining at 1-7, Dataran Loka, Jalan Kuchai Lama, KL 58200 (TheSmartLocal 2025). Menu (Eat Drink KL, Jan 2025): Hotate Paitee (pie tee with butter-poached scallops and pickled beetroot sengkuang), pastas, risotto and rice bowls, Avocado Tartare on sourdough, Coconut Green Soup, a pineapple tepache with brown sugar and cinnamon, taro latte with oat milk, quince cooler with mint. A Dali-inspired mural. Opens at noon; closed Tuesday (Facebook page summary: Wed-Mon 11am-10pm; hours differ between sources).
Signals: Sibling of Bukit Jalil's Scoby Cafe, which called itself Malaysia's first kombucha cafe (Vulcan Post); Eat Drink KL snapshot (Jan 2025); TheSmartLocal '11 New Cafes & Restaurants In Klang Valley In 2025'.
Budget signal: Physical cafe with dinner menu (scallops, risotto) plus media coverage; the team has run cafes since Scoby.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh surrealkl, surrealcafe, scobycafe -> NONE (scoby.com is an unrelated parked domain). (b) No website, Beep, StoreHub or other online ordering found. (c) Scoby Cafe: no website found.
Contacts: IG @surreal_kl; phone 018-329 7260; email surrealkl@gmail.com (Facebook page summary in search results, Nov 2026).
Observation: Eat Drink KL (Jan 2025): 'Surreal is Kuchai Lama's new cafe for whimsy and wonder'; fermentation remains in its DNA.
Angle: Pick-up orders and bottled ferments (tepache / kombucha) to take home, plus Christmas and CNY sets; a website that shows the mural, the menu and the hours (sources disagree on hours today).
Sources: https://eatdrinkkl.blogspot.com/2025/01/surreal-kuchai-lama.html ; https://thesmartlocal.my/cafes-restaurants-kl-2025/ ; https://www.facebook.com/p/Surreal-Cafe-Dining-61571115384460/

leads.name: Restoran 88 (Taman Continental)
leads.contact_source: Malay Mail 2025-05 食评列出的电话
leads.address: 15, Jalan Batalong, Taman Continental, off Jalan Kuchai Lama, 58200 KL
leads.why: Taman Continental 的海鲜大排档：Malay Mail 2025-05 写到苏丹鱼 RM324、砂煲虾汤 RM162，服务好到帮客人剥虾；要订位；没有网站。
leads.verify: 星期三休息；中午 11:30–3pm、晚上 5–11:30pm；查不到 IG，去的时候问老板 WhatsApp 和有没有做农历新年团圆饭 / 外带套餐。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Chinese seafood dai chow at 15, Jalan Batalong, Taman Continental, off Jalan Kuchai Lama, KL. Open-air, surrounded by greenery. Open Thursday to Tuesday, 11.30am-3pm, 5-11.30pm (Malay Mail, May 2025).
Dishes and prices (Malay Mail, May 2025): claypot prawn soup with soy milk, luffa and glass noodles RM162; wild sultan fish 1.8kg steamed RM324; half smoked chicken RM55; petai with choy poh RM38; signature fried mee hoon RM28. Chiefeater: fried pork belly the star; RM100-200 per pax for a seafood dinner.
Signals: Malay Mail review (11 May 2025, Ethan Lau) praising the service (staff peel the prawns and portion the fish for each guest); reservations advised.
Budget signal: RM100-200 per person for seafood dinners.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh restoran88, restoran88kl, 88seafood -> NONE. (b) No website or online ordering found. (c) No other brand found. No Instagram found.
Contacts: phone 012-315 1335 (Malay Mail, May 2025).
Angle: Table bookings without phone calls, Chinese New Year reunion sets and takeaway pre-orders with a cut-off date, a menu with seasonal seafood prices.
Sources: https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2025/05/11/restoran-88-in-taman-continental-serves-great-dai-chow-fare-but-its-the-impeccable-service-yes-they-peel-your-prawns-for-you-that-truly-impresses/176314 ; https://chiefeater.com/chiefeaters/restoran-88-seafood-dinner/

leads.name: Goon Wah Restaurant (Kuchai Jaya)
leads.contact_source: Trusted Malaysia 2024-10 Kuchai Lama 华人餐厅清单列出的电话
leads.address: G13, Jalan 3/115C, Taman Kuchai Jaya, 58200 KL
leads.why: Taman Kuchai Jaya 的老字号粤菜（鱼头米粉、瓦煲老鼠粉），1997 年从自助餐外烩起家，共 3 间分店，人均 RM50–100；没有网站。
leads.verify: 只开早上到下午 4 点（星期日休息）；查不到 IG；问他们现在还做不做外烩、有没有农历新年套餐。B 级：报道比较旧。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Cantonese restaurant at G13, Jalan 3/115C, Taman Kuchai Jaya, KL 58200: XO fish head noodles, claypot lou shu fun, deep-fried fish head, stir-fried pork intestines, Guinness-marinated chicken wings. Open about 7.45am-4pm, closed Sunday.
Signals: Began as a buffet catering service in 1997 (Food Advisor), outlets also in Damansara Jaya and First Plaza; Time Out KL and KLFoodie list it as a Kuchai Lama favourite; Chiefeater brunch review RM50-100 per pax.
Budget signal: RM50-100 per person (Chiefeater); catering background.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh goonwah, goonwahrestaurant -> NONE. (b) No website or online ordering found (Trusted Malaysia lists a Facebook page as the website). (c) No other brand found. No Instagram found.
Contacts: phone 012-297 7284 (Trusted Malaysia, Oct 2024).
Angle: Catering and party-order enquiries online (their roots), Chinese New Year sets with a cut-off date, one website for the three outlets.
Sources: https://trustedmalaysia.com/best-chinese-restaurants-in-kuchai-lama ; https://foodadvisor.my/restaurants/restaurant-goon-wah-kuchai-lama ; https://chiefeater.com/chiefeaters/main-ridge-estate-lunch

leads.name: Sin Chua Kee Seafood Restaurant
leads.contact_source: Trusted Malaysia 2024-09 / 2024-10 清单列出的电话；座机来自其他清单
leads.address: 47, Jalan Kuchai Lama 1, Taman Lian Hoe, 58100 KL
leads.why: Taman Lian Hoe 的老字号海鲜煮炒：螃蟹 RM48 起、娘惹蒸鱼、麦片虾；只有 Facebook，没有网站。
leads.verify: 傍晚 5:30 才开（星期二休息）；查不到 IG；问他们农历新年团圆饭 / 外带怎么接单。B 级：报道比较旧。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Chinese seafood tze char at 47, Jalan Kuchai Lama 1, Taman Lian Hoe, KL. Dinner only, about 5.30-11.30pm, closed Tuesday. Crabs from RM48 (Burpple); buttermilk crab, sin gua tofu, yam basket, Nyonya steamed fish, marmite pork ribs, kam heong crabs.
Signals: One of the oldies in Kuchai Lama (KLFoodie 2019); listed by Trusted Malaysia (2024) as a must-try; Burpple and Wanderlog reviews on fast, friendly service.
Budget signal: Seafood dinners with crabs from RM48; family groups.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh sinchuakee, sinchuakeeseafood -> NONE. (b) No website or online ordering found; Trusted Malaysia lists the Facebook page (RestaurantSinChuaKee) as the website. (c) No other brand found. No Instagram found.
Contacts: mobile 012-688 8022 (Trusted Malaysia 2024); landline 03-7981 6023 (other listings).
Angle: Chinese New Year reunion dinner bookings and takeaway sets with a cut-off date; a menu page with seasonal crab prices.
Sources: https://www.trustedmalaysia.com/guide-to-kuchai-lama/ ; https://trustedmalaysia.com/best-chinese-restaurants-in-kuchai-lama ; https://burpple.com/restoran-sin-chua-kee

leads.name: Simply Thai (Happy Garden)
leads.contact_source: FooTinder 店家资料（聚合网站，店名和号码在同一页）；要先确认
leads.address: LG2-1, Seri Gembira Avenue 6, Jalan Senang Ria, Taman Gembira, 58200 KL
leads.why: Happy Garden 的泰国菜，适合大团体和家庭聚餐，人均 RM50–100；只在 GrabFood 上，没有自己的网站。
leads.verify: 号码来自聚合网站，去的时候先确认；查不到 IG；看他们 Grab 抽成多少，卖点是自己的自取 / 订位网站。B 级：报道比较旧。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Thai restaurant at Unit LG2-1, Seri Gembira Avenue 6, Jalan Senang Ria, Taman Gembira (Happy Garden), KL 58200. Open daily 11am-10pm (Time Out). Green curry, deep-fried kangkung, pandan chicken, pork knuckle.
Signals: The Star (Oct 2018, 'Simply flavourful Thai dining'); Time Out KL listing; Bangsar Babe (Nov 2021); Chiefeater dinner for five (RM50-100 per pax).
Budget signal: RM50-100 per person; big-group and family dinners.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh simplythai, simplythaikl, simplythaimy -> NONE. (b) Only a GrabFood listing (allowed); no own website or ordering page. (c) No other brand found. No Instagram found.
Contacts: phone 010-555 6086 (FooTinder listing; confirm in person).
Angle: Their own pick-up ordering page without Grab's commission, group bookings, festive sets.
Sources: https://timeout.com/kuala-lumpur/restaurants/simply-thai ; https://www.thestar.com.my/metro/eat-and-drink/2018/10/17/simply-flavourful-thai-dining ; https://en.footinder.app/places/655c67fcb69ad2f4baaca332
